name: Resend

params.name: from
params.description: Sender on a verified domain, e.g. you@yourdomain.com

params.name: to
params.description: Recipient address or array of addresses

endpoints.summary: Retrieve a sent email by id

docsDigest: Resend transactional email API. Auth: Bearer API key. Send with POST /emails: from must be an address on a domain you have verified in Resend, plus to, subject, and html or text. JSON bodies. A write, so Skales asks you to confirm before it sends.
notes: Keyless template. Add your Resend API key locally in Skales (Settings, API Connector) and confirm the base host. Sending requires a verified domain in your Resend account.
